paite: Vaihawmte leh thuneite nuai a kitahlut a thumang ding leh thil hoih chiteng sem ding a mansa a om ding in sinsak inla,
heading: Khristian Tatdan Kilawm

paite: kuamah gensiatlouhdan ding, vuallemtak a omdan ding, mi tengteng lak a thunuailutna chiteng hihlang a, nunnem ding in amaute theikhe thaksak nawn in.
Ei leng nidanglai in mihai, thumang lou, khem a om, utna leh kipahna chiteng sem, gilou leh hazat hat a om, kihhuai leh kihotuahte i hi uhi.
Himahleh Pathian, i hondampa migitdan leh mihing tung a a-itdan ahong kilat lai in,
diktatna a i thilhihte ziak hilou, azahngaihna ziak a pianthakna a sawp in leh Kha Siangthou a thaksakna in eite ahon hondamta hi.
Huai Kha Siangthou, Jesu Khrist i Hondampa ziak in nakpitak in i tung ah asungbota hi.
Huchi a ahehpihna a siamtansak a om in, lametna a tangtawn hinna gouluahte i hihtheihna ding in.
Hiai thugen adik ahi. Hiai thilte na phut tinten ka hon deih hi, huchi a Pathian gingtasate'n thil hoih hih ding a apilvan theihna ding un; hiaite mihingte a ding in ahoih in aphatuam uhi.
Himahleh dotna haihuai, khangthu suina, kiselna, dan thu a kilaina nungngatsan in; huaite thil phatuam lou leh bangmah lou ahi.
Ginna tuam neimi zaw khatvei nihvei hilh nung in deih ke'n.
Huchibang mi lampial leh gilou ahi chih thei in, amah mah siam louh akitangsak ahi.
Artemas hiam, Taikikas hiam, na kiang a ka hon sawl chiang in, Nikopolis ah ka kiang ah hong pai teitei in; hiai mun a phalbi zat ka tum hi.
heading: Thuhilhna Nanungte

paite: Dansiam, Zenas leh Apollos azinna ua bangkim ataksaplouhna ding un, phatuamngaitak in na panpih un.
I mite'n leng ataksap khawktakte uh asuktuah theihna ding un leh gah lou a a-omlouhna ding un thil hoih hih a kuhkal ding in zil uhen.
Ka kiang a om tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Ginna a kei hon itte chibai hon buksak in. Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
